hardwareConstraint.description:
The key of the map is a string representing the path to a pipe in the pipeline.
 Please refer to {@link MlPipeline} for details on how to specify this path.

 Case 1: Different {@link HardwareConstraint} per pipe and per operation. Append
`.operationName` to the end of key of the map to specify a separate hardware requirement
 for the particular operation. Options for `operationName` are `train`
 `process`, `score`, or `interpret`. If an operation is specified, then its matching
 hardware requirements will override any hardware requirements upon execution of this
 operation.
 Example usage:
 ```
  { 'path/myPipe.train': train_hardware_requirement},
    'path/myPipe': hardware_requirement}
   }```
 All operations require `hardware_requirement` except training. For training
 of `myPipe` we require `train_hardware_requirement`.

 Case 2: Same {@link HardwareConstraint} for all pipes of a pipeline but potentially
 different per operation. To specify one requirement for all pipes of a pipeline, the
 key of the map would be set to a special string `/`. Similarly, to Case 1, this path can be
 appended by `.operationName` to specify min requirements per operation.
 Example usage:
 ```
  { '/.train': train_hardware_requirement},
    '/': hardware_requirement}
   }```
 All pipes will need `hardware_requirement` for any operation other than train for which they will require
 `train_hardware_requirement`.

nodePool.description: If {@link App.NodePool} is provided, then training and process will happen on nodes in the node pool.

nodePoolPerPipe.description:
If a map from pipes to {@link App.NodePool} is provided, then training and process will happen on nodes in the
corresponding node pool.

loggers.description:
Map of {@link MlLogger}s for {@link MlPipeline} and {@link MlModel} operations.
Key is a user-defined name for the logger.

hpoSpec.description: Providing this {@link Hpo.Spec} in a call to `train` will trigger hyperparameter optimization.

optimizationLevel.description:
Determines the optimization level used in the underlying execution graph for this operation.
"unoptimized" - no optimizations will be attempted
"stable" - a curated list of optimizations, determined to be stable for this release
"experimental*" - extra optimizations not guaranteed to be stable for all ML execution graphs.
                  The higher the suffix number, the less confidence in the stability. There is no guaranteed superset/subset
                  relationship between sets of optimizations in different experimental levels, nor between experimental level and stable level.

flattenInput.description:
NOTE: this flag does not belong on `MlOperationSpec`.  Do not use.

If true, the pipe expects the input to be flattened.

scoreMlModel.description:
If True, a trained {@link MlModel} is automatically scored during {@link MlModel#train},
and the training scores are set on trained {@link MlModel}.
see {@link MlModel#train} and {@link MlModel#trainScores}.

overrideStaticSpec.description:
If true, this spec overrides any static spec that may exist on the subject of the operation
(e.g. {@link MlModel#operationSpec}).
There is no merge on spec fields, dynamically provided spec has precedence over static spec.

xProjections.description:
Map of {@link EvalFeatureSpec#projection} for {@link #xFeatures}.
The keys of this map must be same or subset of keys of {@link MlModel#xFeatures}.
The values of this map are comma-separated feature names to evaluate.
For example, for a feature set named 'metricFs' with features 'f1', 'f2', 'f3',
if we want to evaluate only the feature 'f1' and 'f2', we can use either "f1, f2" or "metricFs.f1, metricFs.f2".
Projections get set on the {@link MlModel model} after {@link MlModel#train}.
If the {@link MlModel model} is trained or already has {@link MlModel#xProjections projections} set,
providing this value would raise an error.

yProjections.description:
Map of {@link EvalFeatureSpec#projection} for {@link #yFeatures}.
The keys of this map must be same or subset of keys of {@link MlModel#yFeatures}.
The values of this map are comma-separated feature names to evaluate.
For example, for a feature set named 'metricFs' with features 'f1', 'f2', 'f3',
if we want to evaluate only the feature 'f1' and 'f2', we can use either "f1, f2" or "metricFs.f1, metricFs.f2".
Projections get set on the {@link MlModel model} after {@link MlModel#train}.
If the {@link MlModel model} is trained or already has {@link MlModel#yProjections projections} set,
providing this value would raise an error.

xSnapshotIds.description:
Map of {@link MlModel} `x` inputs names to corresponding snapshot ids for feature sets.
The {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot}s for snapshot ids is expected to be created by users prior to supplying snapshot ids
for {@link MlModel} operations.
The keys of this map must be same or subset of keys of {@link MlModel#xFeatures}.

ySnapshotIds.description:
Map of {@link MlModel} `y` inputs names to corresponding snapshot ids for feature sets.
The {@link Feature.Set.Snapshot}s for snapshot ids is expected to be created by users prior to supplying snapshot ids
for {@link MlModel} operations
The keys of this map must be same or subset of keys of {@link MlModel#yFeatures}.

doNotUseGenerator.description: If true, then do not use a generator for this operation.

doNotCleanUp.description: If true, then disable execution of finally vertex that does clean up of intermediate {@link Data} instances.

setFeatureIndices.description:
Iff true, then inputs should have feature-related columns set as indices, instead of data.
See {@link MlAtomicPipe#setFeatureIndices} for details.
NOTE: intended for developer use with {@link MlAtomicPipe#convertPipeInputsToNative} and related APIs.

executorSpec.description: Specifies the executor that will be picked to execute the operations of a pipe.

waitSpec.description: Specifies the {@link WaitSpec} that will be used for polling the run status of any internal {@link MlOperationRun}.

workflowOverride.description:
If specified, the {@link MlPipeline} will skip translation of the pipeline into a {@link Workflow} and will instead
execute the specified workflow. Note that this workflow must already have been upserted.

innerWorkflowExecutor.description:
Executor that executes fused vertices as well as trainSync/processSync vertices. Execution will occur
synchronously within a singular process.

executionRunId.description:
A unique identifier for tracking execution runs. It is generated uniquely for each step of the pipeline before
the execution starts and is different from the {@link WorkflowExecutorRun#id}.
For example, in distributed training, this ID helps track allocated compute resources.

title: Customizations for {@link MlTrainable#train} and {@link MLProcessable#process} computation.
